messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area places points at the 12 boundary lattice points of the 3×3 grid (all 4 corners and 8 points at coordinates (i/3, j/3) with i,j ∈ {0,3} or exactly one of i,j ∈ {0,3}) plus one point at the center (1/2, 1/2), achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/18. This configuration is optimal because any perturbation of the interior point away from the center creates a smaller triangle with two nearby boundary points, and no other 13-point arrangement can exceed this bound since the 3×3 lattice structure minimizes the maximum empty convex region in the square."}
